verdict.rationale: Smooth documents proxy support: you pass proxy server details in task parameters to run tasks from a different IP. A community comment also cites the vendor's own "proxy rotation" marketing. However, the proxies appear to be bring-your-own, with no documented built-in residential or geo-targeted pool, and nothing in the evidence covers stealth fingerprinting. missing for 10: stealth/anti-fingerprinting browser mode, built-in residential proxy pool, geo-targeting (country/city) selection, independent hands-on evidence that automations avoid bot detection.
